lens.description: Filter by lens model substring match.

sort.description: Sort order. Default is reverse-chronological. 'popular' ranks by like count within the optional window. 'relevant' ranks keyword matches by where the term hit (text > alt > location > categories > exif) and applies only when 'keyword' is set.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return.

media.description: One kind of post only: photos or videos. Absent returns both.

aiFilter.description: Filter by AI declaration: no-ai, ai-assisted, contains-ai.

category.description: Filter by photography category (e.g. landscape, portrait, street).

filmLens.description: Filter by the hand-typed film lens in postMeta.film.lens, matched exactly (case-insensitively). Distinct from `lens`, which matches EXIF with a substring.

cameraMake.description: Filter by camera manufacturer (e.g. Sony, Canon, Fujifilm).

filmCamera.description: Filter by the hand-typed film body in postMeta.film.camera, matched exactly (case-insensitively). Distinct from cameraModel, which matches EXIF — on a film scan the EXIF describes the scanner, so a film body only ever appears here.

cameraModel.description: Filter by camera model (e.g. A7R V, X-T5).

main.description: Retrieve a feed of Zeens photos and videos with optional filters by camera, category, and engagement.
